+## Summary
+
+Increase the pricing cache TTL from 15 minutes (900 seconds) to 1 hour (3600 seconds) to reduce the frequency of cache refreshes and improve availability when the pricing feed is temporarily delayed.
+
+## Changes
+
+- Updated `CACHE_TTL_SECONDS` from 900 to 3600 in `pricing_cache.py`
+- Removed the `lookup()` function which provided fallback behavior to previous snapshots
+
+## Rationale
+
+A longer cache TTL gives the system more resilience to upstream feed delays and reduces load on the pricing service. This allows cached pricing data to remain valid for a full hour, reducing the likelihood of requests hitting stale data or triggering unnecessary cache misses during temporary feed outages.
